environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Amazon ECS Fargate with a task role that has full DynamoDB access. Container runs as root with a writable filesystem. The application is behind an ALB with no additional middleware. The container image is based on mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:8.0 (Debian-based). The /app/uploads directory is on the container's ephemeral storage with no read-only mount restrictions. No seccomp or AppArmor profiles are applied beyond the default Docker runtime.
